name: WeKnora MCP Server (optional)
description: Optional Streamable HTTP client for a WeKnora MCP server (hybrid_search / list_knowledge / get_knowledge). Disabled by default. Prefer NLM's weknora_* tools + WEKNORA_BASE_URL. This is not a second knowledge platform.

config.notes: Point at WeKnora mcp-server Streamable HTTP (WEKNORA_MCP_URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000). Useful tools if you want the agent to call WeKnora MCP directly: hybrid_search, list_knowledge, get_knowledge. Leave disabled unless that process is running.
